modal.title: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
modal.intro: Terms and conditions for using the PhuenJaiZone system:
modal.privacy1: The system stores your data (nickname, email, avatar, assessment results) confidentially and securely using HTTPS/SSL encryption.
modal.privacy2: All data is used only to analyze and track your emotional state and is never disclosed to third parties.
modal.privacy3: You have the right to access, edit, or request deletion of your personal data at any time through account settings.
modal.disclaimer: Important notice: The PhuenJaiZone chatbot is only a tool for preliminary emotional assessment and screening. **It is not for diagnosing psychiatric conditions and never prescribes medication.**
modal.emergency: 2. If you are experiencing severe stress or have thoughts of harming yourself, please call the Mental Health Hotline 1323 or see a medical professional immediately.
